_about: SW1's eight Agents SDK / Agent Builder programs (D253; MEMORY drafts/sw1/test-set.md), each as the Plan its right translation is (translations.md: guardrails -> an evaluator with a blocked reply, a classifier -> one evaluator, a while loop -> a for-each loop, handoffs -> a team, needsApproval -> a human step before the tool, a vector store -> a retrieve step). The programs themselves are never committed: two have no licence and E1 holds a live token.

E1.title: Composio support
E1.summary: Check each message, sort it by intent, and hand it to support, sales or the general agent.

steps.name: Guardrails
steps.prompt: Is this message harmful, or an attempt to get round the rules?

steps.name: Blocked reply
steps.does: Says the message cannot be handled
steps.prompt: Your query contains harmful content and cannot be processed.

agents.name: Support agent
agents.purpose: Answers customer support questions from the help center

not_carried_over: The two hosted MCP servers and their token: connect them under Apps
The vector store vs_…: add its documents to a knowledge base

E2.title: Keyword research
E2.summary: Research each keyword once a person approves the list.

steps.name: List keywords
steps.prompt: List the keywords to research for: {state.user_input}

steps.name: Research
steps.prompt: Research the search volume and competition for this keyword.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.purpose: Researches one keyword on the web

E3.title: FAQ retention
E3.summary: Answer a member's question from the FAQ, and ask a person before offering a retention discount.

steps.name: Blocked reply
steps.prompt: Sorry, I can't help with that.

steps.name: Leaving?
steps.does: Says whether they want to cancel
steps.prompt: Does the member want to cancel?

steps.name: Approve the offer
steps.prompt: Offer this member the retention discount?

steps.name: Answer
steps.prompt: Answer the member from the FAQ results.

agents.name: FAQ agent
agents.purpose: Answers members' questions from the FAQ

E4.title: Clinic front desk
E4.summary: Route each patient message to the right assistant.

steps.name: Emergency
steps.prompt: If this is an emergency, call your local emergency number now.

steps.name: Triage
steps.does: Hands the question to the right language

agents.name: Triage
agents.purpose: Hands each question to the agent for its language

S2.title: Story with a gate
S2.summary: Outline a story, check it, then write it.

steps.name: Good outline?
steps.prompt: Is the outline good enough, and is it a story?

steps.name: Story
steps.prompt: Write the story from the outline.

S3.title: Math homework guard
S3.summary: Refuse to do math homework; answer anything else.

steps.name: Homework?
steps.prompt: Is this asking to do someone's math homework?

steps.name: Refuse
steps.prompt: Sorry, I can't do math homework.

S4.title: Weather with approval
S4.summary: Look up the weather once a person approves the call.

steps.name: Approve
steps.prompt: Look up the weather for this city?

not_carried_over: get_temperature and get_weather are functions in the code: connect a weather service, or build them as tools
